output.answer: Brex no longer has a standalone valuation: fintech unicorn Brex was acquired by Capital One, which announced the deal on January 22, 2026 at $5.15 billion (50% cash, 50% stock) and completed it on April 7, 2026. That price was a steep discount — less than half — of Brex's last private-market valuation of $12.3 billion, set at its January 2022 Series D-2 round. At closing, the SEC filing showed consideration of approximately $2.56 billion in cash plus 10,646,306 Capital One shares. Brex now operates as a Capital One business unit (founder Pedro Franceschi remains its CEO), so any 'valuation' today is effectively its ~$5.15 billion acquisition price.
caveats: The $5.15 billion figure is the announced deal value on January 22, 2026; because half the consideration was Capital One stock, the actual value at the April 7, 2026 closing moved with COF's share price (the closing SEC filing shows ~$2.56 billion cash plus 10,646,306 shares), so the final realized value may differ from $5.15 billion.
As a wholly owned Capital One subsidiary since April 2026, Brex has no independent market valuation; the $5.15 billion acquisition price is the best current proxy.

The $12.3 billion figure is Brex's last private (venture) valuation from its 2022 Series D-2 round; no independently verified higher or more recent private valuation was found between 2022 and the 2026 sale.

passages.quote: APRIL 7, 2026 -- Capital One Financial Corporation (NYSE: COF) today announced that it has completed its acquisition of Brex in a combination of stock and cash transaction.

Capital One is acquiring payments startup Brex for $5.15 billion, the latest splashy deal undertaken by CEO Richard Fairbank. ... The bank disclosed the deal in its fourth-quarter earnings statement. ... Brex was previously valued at $12.3 billion. The more than 50% decline in valuation shows the headwinds that even successful fintechs have encountered.
Capital One will acquire Brex for $5.15 billion in cash and stock ... That figure represents less than half of Brex's last private-market valuation of $12.3 billion from its 2022 Series D-2 round.

Capital One Financial Corp. (NYSE:COF) announced Tuesday it has completed the acquisition of Brex Inc., a Delaware-based corporation, for approximately $2.56 billion in cash and 10,646,306 shares of Capital One common stock. The transaction was conducted under the terms of a previously disclosed merger agreement dated January 22, 2026.

key_facts.fact: Capital One completed its acquisition of Brex on April 7, 2026 in a stock-and-cash transaction; Brex founder Pedro Franceschi continues as CEO of Brex under Capital One.
Capital One announced on January 22, 2026 that it was acquiring Brex for $5.15 billion, 50% cash and 50% stock, disclosed in its Q4 2025 earnings statement.
Brex's last private-market valuation was $12.3 billion, set at its Series D-2 round in January 2022; the $5.15 billion acquisition price is less than half that peak valuation.

Per the closing SEC filing, the completed transaction consisted of approximately $2.56 billion in cash plus 10,646,306 shares of Capital One common stock, under the merger agreement dated January 22, 2026.
Brex itself confirmed its $12.3 billion valuation in January 2022 (Series D-2).
